pages.ko: 할머니 댁에 가는 날! 호리네 가족이 차를 타고 신나게 출발했어요. 호리는 카시트에 앉아 창밖을 보며 콧노래를 불러요. "룰루랄라, 얼른 가자!"
pages.t: It's the day to visit Grandma's house! Hori's family hopped in the car and set off excitedly. Hori sat in his car seat, humming a tune as he looked out the window. "La la la, let's hurry there!"

pages.ko: 그런데 차가 멈췄어요. 앞에 차들이 줄줄이— 길이 꽉 막혔어요. 가도 가도 멈춰만 있어요. 호리는 점점 심심해져서 몸을 배배 꼬았어요. "언제 가아…"
pages.t: But then the car stopped. Cars lined up ahead one after another— the road was jammed. No matter how much they drove, they just kept stopping. Hori grew more and more bored and squirmed in his seat. "When are we gonna get there…"

pages.ko: 기다림은 자꾸만 길어져요. "심심해— 아직도 멀었어?" 호리가 발을 동동 굴러요. 창밖은 여전히 똑같은 풍경, 시계 바늘은 느릿느릿. 호리 입이 삐죽삐죽 나왔어요.
pages.t: The wait dragged on and on. "I'm bored— are we there yet?" Hori stomped his feet. Outside the window was the same scenery as always, and the clock hands crept along slowly. Hori's lips stuck out in a pout.

pages.ko: 그때 엄마가 눈을 찡긋했어요. "호리야, 우리 상상 놀이 할까? 심심할 땐, 상상 놀이!" "상상 놀이가 뭐야?" 호리가 귀를 쫑긋 세웠어요.
pages.t: Just then, Mom gave a little wink. "Hori, shall we play a make-believe game? When you're bored, it's time for imagination play!" "What's imagination play?" Hori's ears perked up.

pages.ko: "눈을 감고 상상해 봐. 네 의자가 커다란 배라고!" 호리가 상상하자— 우와! 카시트가 출렁출렁 파란 바다 위 배가 되었어요. "정말 배가 됐어! 출발— 심심할 땐, 상상 놀이!"
pages.t: "Close your eyes and imagine. Your car seat is a big ship!" As Hori imagined it— whoa! His car seat became a ship rocking on the blue sea. "It really became a ship! Let's set sail— bored? Time for imagination play!"

pages.ko: 이번엔 호리 차례예요. "저 빨간 신호등은— 하늘에서 내려온 마법 별!" 호리가 창밖을 가리키며 깔깔 웃어요. 심심하던 창밖이 온통 신기한 것투성이가 됐어요.
pages.t: Now it was Hori's turn. "That red traffic light is— a magic star that fell from the sky!" Hori pointed out the window and giggled. The once-boring view outside became full of amazing things.

pages.ko: "저 뭉게구름은 폭신폭신 양 같아!" "이건 코가 긴 코끼리야!" 호리와 엄마가 번갈아 구름을 동물로 바꿔요. 심심할 땐, 상상 놀이! 어느새 기다림이 하나도 지루하지 않아요.
pages.t: "That fluffy cloud looks like a soft, puffy sheep!" "This one's an elephant with a long trunk!" Hori and Mom took turns turning clouds into animals. Bored? Time for imagination play! Before they knew it, the wait wasn't boring at all.

pages.ko: 깔깔깔! 온 가족이 상상 놀이로 신났어요. 그 순간 호리 꼬리 줄무늬가 무지개색으로 반짝— 심심함을 즐거움으로 바꿔낸 거예요! 호리가 스스로 해냈어요.
pages.t: Giggle, giggle, giggle! The whole family had a blast with the imagination game. At that moment, the stripes on Hori's tail sparkled in rainbow colors— he had turned boredom into fun! Hori did it all by himself.

pages.ko: 이제 호리는 상상 놀이 방법을 알아요. 하나, 눈앞의 물건을 다른 걸로 상상하기! 둘, 창밖 구름을 동물로 바꾸기! 셋, 엄마랑 번갈아 이야기 이어가기! "다음에 심심하면 또 하자!"
pages.t: Now Hori knows how to play the imagination game. One, imagine the things in front of you as something else! Two, turn the clouds outside into animals! Three, take turns telling the story with Mom! "Let's do it again next time I'm bored!"

pages.ko: 어느새 할머니 댁에 도착! 엄마가 호리를 꼭 안아 주었어요. "기다리는 동안 심심함을 즐겁게 바꾼 우리 호리, 최고야!" 이제 호리는 알아요. 심심한 순간도 상상으로 바꾸면 재밌어진다는 걸. 심심할 땐, 상상 놀이!
pages.t: Before they knew it, they arrived at Grandma's house! Mom gave Hori a big hug. "Our Hori turned a boring wait into so much fun, that's amazing!" Now Hori knows that even boring moments can become fun with a little imagination. Bored? Time for imagination play!
